Massapequa Park Bicycle Club Rides

Bethpage, NY · Long Island · Road

Massapequa Park Bicycle Club Rides is a road group ride in Bethpage, NY. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays and Saturdays and Sundays at 8:30 am from Bethpage Public Library (most common start; others on the calendar). About 40–70 miles, b through A+ pace groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: b through A+ pace groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @massapequa_park_bike_club the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Massapequa Park Bicycle Club Rides group ride

A Long Island road club with midweek and weekend rides for a range of speeds. Many rides leave from the Bethpage library; others start out east or upstate. Each ride on the calendar lists pace, distance and start. The club meets the first Tuesday of the month in Plainview.
